messages:
nina: customer reported duplicate confirmed charges after a stream retried mid-toolcall. attaching minimal trace.

ron: can you dump the ids + short logs?

nina: req=qx_11, sess=S-11, initial route=asia-east-1, fallback=asia-east-1-b

kevin: logs: ```
2026-04-05T08:05:01Z INFO stream.start id=qx_11 route=asia-east-1
2026-04-05T08:05:02Z INFO toolcall start mailer delta=+5
2026-04-05T08:05:03Z WARN client-eof early_eof
2026-04-05T08:05:03Z INFO reconnect id=qx_11-r1 route=asia-east-1-b forwarded_headers=[Idempotency-Key]
2026-04-05T08:05:04Z INFO provisional ledger=pr-11 amount=+5 ttl=3s
2026-04-05T08:05:05Z INFO confirm ledger=cf-11 amount=+5
2026-04-05T08:05:05Z INFO confirm ledger=cf-12 amount=+5
```

ron: looks like two confirms. Did the fallback runtime see the in-flight toolcall?

kevin: no, fallback didn't observe a marker. Our in-memory inflight flag lived only on the original runtime. reconnect lost state; both sides wound up confirming.

nina: ops asks for short term: can we pause confirms on fallback if a recent provisional exists for same session? even a 2s debounce would cut most dupes.

ron: short-term hack: router can forward a header X-Provisional-At with timestamp when it sees a provisional on original route; fallback runtimes delay confirm for (now - X-Provisional-At) up to max 5s. Low-risk and quick.

kevin: long-term: we should write a tombstone to a tiny shared store when a provisional exists and clear it when toolcall completes. fallback runtimes consult tombstone before confirming. trade-off: extra write on provisional creation.

ops-bot: ticket OP-942 created: "fallback confirm debounce via X-Provisional-At header" assigned to @ron.

billing-bot: temp billing rule: mark confirms that occur within 5s of a provisional for same session as "suspect" and hold invoice. tagging billing-team.

ron: plan: (1) router header passthrough PR (X-Provisional-At) behind flag, (2) metric `billing.confirm.debounce_hits`, (3) billing hold rule, (4) follow up design doc for tombstone store. PR by EOD, rollout behind flag next week.

nina: thanks. I'll keep the invoice on hold for the affected customer and send an update when flag is live.

all: :thumbsup:
